searchText: For cases where the precompile can be fully expressed in EVM, yes. But in cases such as L2 bridging and other actions that cross layers a magical system contract is often the only way to express it. This is about BLOCKHASH system contract does anyone have an idea why in the bandersnatch paper curve equation for short weistrass form is: y^3=x^2 - 3763200000x − 78675968000000. Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2021/1152.pdf and arkworks has different parameters: https://github.com/arkworks-rs/algebra/blob/master/curves/ed_on_bls12_381_bandersnatch/src/curves/mod.rs#L43 cc <@427491045308235776> answer is here: https://github.com/arkworks-rs/curves/pull/158#discussion_r1323172895 note: this shouldn't impact any implementation since verkle uses twisted edwards form iiuc
